holidays.name: National Bacon Day
holidays.description: A sizzling celebration of everyone's favorite crispy, salty breakfast meat. Fans fry up strips, wrap it around anything edible, and sneak it into desserts like maple bacon doughnuts and chocolate-covered slices.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food holiday that spread mostly through social media and food-enthusiast circles. Some sources place bacon celebrations around December 30, while others also observe the International Bacon Day on the Saturday before Labor Day, so the date is a bit fuzzy.
holidays.funFact: Bacon has been cured and eaten for thousands of years, and Chinese people are believed to have been salting pork bellies as early as 1500 BC.
